honesty_footer.detection_inputs_policy: Detection inputs missing for some symbols (RS needs 21 sessions, ADR/RVOL need 20 priors): such symbols are excluded from that detector, not zero-filled.
honesty_footer.history_depth: The bhavcopy archive spans 2010-2026 (~4000 sessions). The nightly ingest loads the most recent ~2 years (~600 files) to fit memory; 52-week-high and long-window features are computed against that window, not the full archive. Symbols with shorter histories carry an honest 'DISTANCE_52W_UNAVAILABLE' note.
honesty_footer.adjustment_note: Data source: NSE bhavcopy (EQ series). Confirmed CA table applied as a derived view at scan time (4 actions, 2 symbols). Raw prints stay in the store. Official NSE CA-with-ratios still open.
honesty_footer.disclaimer: All outputs are rule results for research review. They are not recommendations, and nothing here places orders.
